decision_anchor.scope: MNT-M2-06 Meta Pixel/Dataset ownership and target topology
decision_anchor.authorization: Product Authority explicitly authorized MNT-M2-06 start on 2026-09-10
decision_anchor.meaning: When this revision is integrated into canonical main through its PR lifecycle, MNT-M2-06 is COMPLETE. The task defines Meta Measurement governance ownership and target topology only; it performs no Meta-side/runtime mutation.

current_execution.reason: MNT-M2-06 is accepted complete when this revision is in canonical main. MNT-M2-09 remains partially implemented from the accepted GTM Consent baseline, but further tracking implementation requires a separate Product Authority execution gate.

next.safe_action: Obtain explicit Product Authority authorization before continuing MNT-M2-09. Start with read-only resolution/adoption of any existing dedicated GA4 and Meta assets and a bounded implementation plan; do not infer permission to publish GTM, create/configure GA4 or Meta assets, enable CAPI, or change production without the applicable explicit mutation scope.
next.mutation_boundary: No further GTM publication, GA4 property/stream creation or event implementation, Meta Dataset/Pixel/CAPI creation or deployment, Green Pixel, Google Ads, DNS, Search Console, Vercel Production or Green production mutation is authorized by MNT-M2-06 design.

key_decisions: GTM-PGCR4R47 is the sole project-owned browser dispatcher
project business Measurement is eligible only on moretegra.com.br, not www.moretegra.com.br
Green /page/view remains platform telemetry and is not forwarded as a project business event
exactly one project page-view path may exist per canonical document load
mnt_event_id is project correlation identity; vendor-native dedup remains destination-specific
only verified Green Form 46 success may become a lead conversion
